purpose: Exercises reconciling a pre-existing genuine Swagger 2.0 document (swagger.yaml, top-level "swagger: 2.0") against discovered routes, per docs/adr/0013-existing-openapi-document-reconciliation.md's v2 extension: GetUser's route fully agrees with the document, GetOrder's route names its path parameter differently than the document (a structural conflict), PlainHandler has no document operation at all, and DELETE /legacy/{id} in the document has no matching route (an orphan). Identical shape to testdata/fixtures/existing-openapi-document, but the document itself is Swagger 2.0 rather than OpenAPI 3.x.

expectedRoutes.note: GetUser: existing-document summary/description/tags and the "id" parameter description are all applied; no diagnostic

GetOrder: existing-document summary still applied (prose is never gated), but the document's "id" parameter name disagrees with the route's own "orderId" — openapi-spec-conflict, marked unrefined for parameters, no parameter description applied
PlainHandler: no corresponding document operation; route.ExistingDocument stays nil

expectedDiagnostics.note: GetOrder's route parameter name "orderId" vs the document's "id"
DELETE /legacy/{id} is documented but not discovered in code

expectedOrphanedOperations.summary: Deprecated legacy delete operation no longer present in code
